correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the three-step Gallo–Videla bracket presentation, including the separate triangle C3 and the all-characteristic alternating Kirillov block on V⊕A with central W. For n≥4, D_{i,i+1}=t_i and D_{i+2,i}=−t_i. Its bipartite support separates into gcd(n,3) cycles. When 3∤n the two full matching monomials coincide, so det D=0 identically; when n=3m its determinant is ±(P0−P1)(P1−P2)(P2−P0), with Pj the products of the m coordinates of residue class j. The triangle mixed block is monomial-diagonal with the three pairwise t differences. Invertible D gives Kirillov rank 2n; otherwise the alternating 2n block has rank at most 2n−2, and explicit rank-(n−1) D witnesses attain 2n−2 even in characteristic two. Thus index n occurs exactly for 3|n, |k|>2; otherwise n+2. The independent product-fiber counting argument gives A=q^m−(q−1)^m, B=(q−1)^(m−1) and the stated 3(q−1)(q−2)AB²+(q−1)(q−2)(q−3)B³ central-coefficient count, times q^(2n) arbitrary noncentral coefficients.

correctness.rationale: Using the exact cycle Lie brackets, the Kirillov form has a 2n-dimensional alternating block with off-diagonal n-by-n mixed matrix D. It is invertible exactly if D is invertible; if D is singular the alternating rank is at most 2n-2. Its support graph splits into gcd(n,3) bipartite cycles, giving determinant zero when 3 does not divide n and a product of three residue-class product differences when 3 divides n; C3 is proved separately. Explicit t choices realize full D rank over fields with more than two elements at divisible lengths, and corank one in all remaining cases including F2. Counting triples of pairwise distinct block products proves the exact finite-field count. The checker verifies 64 witnesses, 6419 exhaustive central assignments and 12730 full noncentral cases; finite checks are not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Kirillov index is a natural exact coadjoint-stabilizer invariant for a canonical new infinite graph-defined nilpotent family. The residue-class determinant gives a sharp all-length classification rather than an arbitrary small-instance recomputation. The distinction between F2 and F4 with the same characteristic is genuinely arithmetic and shows generic-over-closure indices need not descend to the smallest field. The exact finite-field count of minimal-stabilizer functionals refines the index in a way a researcher studying coadjoint rank strata could use. This precise n/q-count does not mechanically follow from center dimension, known path or C4 formulas.
